title: Integer literal types
description: DuckDB types an integer literal as the narrowest type that holds it (duckdb-R1).
reference: `100::TINYINT + 50` is an `i8` addition in DuckDB, and an `i64` one in DataFusion's plan.

provenance.notes: Recorded from the replay's translation of DuckDB's SQL to DataFusion's (`sverify_dev.slt.translate`).
